verdict.rationale: SerpApi ships an official MCP server that lets MCP-compatible AI agents such as Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor use it as a web search tool, so a user can drive searches through natural-language requests. A hands-on report confirms the hosted MCP endpoint exists and supports Bearer auth. However, an external agent interprets the natural language, and nothing shows the product itself accepting natural-language commands. missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface in SerpApi itself, documentation of which operations are reachable via natural language beyond running searches, independent hands-on evidence of NL-driven workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The MCP integration allows any MCP-compatible AI agent (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc.) to use SerpApi as a web search tool.
official MCP server documented at https://github.com/serpapi/serpapi-mcp
A SerpApi rep replied that Bearer auth is already supported at mcp.serpapi.com/mcp.
